body.text: The artist, in her experimental eclecticism, in search of her artistic daimon, autonomous and self-aware, finds in sculpture a code of renewal of the intangible and the spiritual, practised assiduously between 2013 and 2016 — years of fervent study and work.
body.html: The artist, in her experimental eclecticism, in search of her artistic daimon, autonomous and self-aware, finds in sculpture a code of renewal of the intangible and the spiritual, practised assiduously between 2013 and 2016 — years of fervent study and work.

body.text: Boky Hackel-Ward is a restorer, painter, musician, performer and photographer who trained in Florence, where she breathed, lived and absorbed the “grammar” of the Renaissance. Always passionate about poetry and fascinated by the sound of words, with these sculptures she shows a surprising artistic maturity in her ability to conjugate poetry and figuration.
body.html: Boky Hackel-Ward is a restorer, painter, musician, performer and photographer who trained in Florence, where she breathed, lived and absorbed the “grammar” of the Renaissance. Always passionate about poetry and fascinated by the sound of words, with these sculptures she shows a surprising artistic maturity in her ability to conjugate poetry and figuration.

body.text: At the foundry, battling the wax and then the bronze, in the interpenetration of poetry and anthropomorphic, stylised figures, she combines words and shapes to give life to sculptures that become éternelles.
body.html: At the foundry, battling the wax and then the bronze, in the interpenetration of poetry and anthropomorphic, stylised figures, she combines words and shapes to give life to sculptures that become éternelles.

body.text: Her rigorous search for the re-novatio of classicism and the recollection of Visual Poetry materialise into bodies that invite reflection on the difference between the male and female component.

body.text: The voyage that we impend upon in the darkness of a cloudy night, in an effort to vanquish the enemy within; doubt…
body.html: The voyage that we impend upon in the darkness of a cloudy night, in an effort to vanquish the enemy within; doubt…

body.text: Call it rupture, solitude, anguish, fear… all of it, and more, thrown into one violent battleground called our psyche. Where were the gods then?
body.html: Call it rupture, solitude, anguish, fear… all of it, and more, thrown into one violent battleground called our psyche. Where were the gods then?

body.text: It has been this crossing that has forged me as an artist and as a human being.
body.html: It has been this crossing that has forged me as an artist and as a human being.

body.text: The gift is emerging on the other side. The gift is transcending and overcoming the paralysis of silent faith and acquiescence.
body.html: The gift is emerging on the other side. The gift is transcending and overcoming the paralysis of silent faith and acquiescence.

body.text: The gift is that one day we find that thing, that medium, and it no longer matters what we want to be, because we are, now and here. It doesn't even matter if they get us or not. We are finally free to create!
